title: Erdoğan is strangling Turkey’s last free media, as EU turns a blind eye
lede: Turkey's state takeover of independent broadcaster Sözcü TV was met by loud EU silence, in a broader pattern of appeasement, as Erdoğan strangles what is left of free speech.
